Future<void> update(store, groups) async {
  for (final row in await store.rows()) {
    print(row);
  }
  for (final group in groups) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    for (final row in await store.rows(group)) {
      print(row);
    }
  }
  for (final row in await store.rows()) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await store.save(row);
  }
}

void register(kinds, store) {
  for (final kind in kinds) {
    group(kind, () {
      beforeEach(() async {
        for (final row in await store.rows()) {
          // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
          await store.save(row);
        }
        for (final batch in store.batches) {
          // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
          for (final row in await store.rows(batch)) {
            print(row);
          }
        }
      });
    });
  }
}
